description: Computer use smoke: move the pointer with desktop_move, read the exact position from the tool status line (not from the picture), write it to a file, and prove it with the fixture verifier. Requires a desktop (or the Linux virtual desktop) on the server.
prompt: Use the desktop_* tools (computer use). Take a desktop_screenshot and note the screen size from its status line ("Screen WxH px"). Then call desktop_move with x=0.25 and y=0.75 and read the pointer position that the status line reports as a fraction. Write exactly one line into screen.txt: that fraction as X,Y with three decimals (for example 0.250,0.750), followed by a single newline. Then run `node verify.js`, and in your reply state the screen size and the verifier output.
